title: MOBO-Envelope: code and data for "Multi-Objective Optimisation of Building Envelopes: A Surrogate-Assisted Three-Tier Verification Framework"
description: Code, input data, results and figures for the article Multi-Objective Optimisation of Building Envelopes: A Surrogate-Assisted Three-Tier Verification Framework (Building and Environment, 2026). MOBO-Envelope optimises thermal, structural, daylight and cost objectives with a surrogate-assisted NSGA-III search (Path-A) and verifies the results with standards-grade Python simulators (Path-B) and EnergyPlus/Radiance (Path-C) for three climate-zone case studies (Houston, New York City, Minneapolis).
